title: Zero-fit mechanism audit of the C5A pooled signed bottom-flux blocker
scientific_question: Is the sole C5A blocking component primarily caused by LARE time integration, residual state-resolution insufficiency, dynamic lower-boundary closure response, or cross-history cancellation in the R2 comparator?

known_trigger.interpretation: These are already observed C5A facts and motivate C5B. C5B is not response-blind and must not be presented as confirmatory acceptance evidence.

frozen_workload.lower_boundary: exact C5A fixed-domain prescribed-head RISE/FALL and mode-2 HOLD
frozen_workload.LARE_partitions: exact C5A R5, R8 and R16 only for mechanism diagnosis

R2_aggregation: mean absolute history-specific signed bottom-flux mean
phase-specific signed mean and RMSE for PHASE1, PHASE2 and HOLD

outputs: estimated convergence order when numerically defined
Richardson-style dt->0 signed-mean extrapolation when numerically defined
full bottom-flux timeseries distance between dt=1e-4 and dt=2.5e-5
R5-to-R16 and R8-to-R16 bottom-flux timeseries distances
signed-bias and RMSE at each member

closure_counterfactual.purpose: mechanism sensitivity; never C5A rescue or admission

effect_size_labels.reference: current-face R16 dt=2.5e-5 pooled bottom-flux RMSE to exact C5A R16 Reference
effect_size_labels.SMALL_LT_0P1_RESIDUAL: effect-size RMSE below one tenth of that residual
effect_size_labels.COMPARABLE_0P1_TO_1_RESIDUAL: effect-size RMSE between one tenth and one times that residual
effect_size_labels.LARGE_GT_RESIDUAL: effect-size RMSE larger than that residual
effect_size_labels.interpretation: Mechanism-description labels only. They are not hydrological acceptance thresholds.

analysis_questions: Does timestep refinement materially move the signed-bias floor toward zero or toward the R2 pooled bias?
At fine timestep, is R8-to-R16 or R5-to-R16 state-resolution change negligible relative to the current-face Reference residual?
Does switching only the pre-existing lower-boundary conductivity closure produce an effect comparable to or larger than the current-face Reference residual?
Which boundary phases carry the persistent signed error?
How much of R2's exceptionally small pooled bias is due to cancellation among history-specific signed errors?

decision_language.rule: Report continuous effect sizes first. Multiple labels may apply. Do not force a single causal winner unless evidence separates mechanisms clearly.

pre_execution_implementation_binding.reason: C5B is explicitly a post-C5A mechanism audit. The analysis plan is frozen before any new C5B diagnostic run, but it is not independent of C5A observations.
pre_execution_implementation_binding.allowed_new_code: diagnostic reruns of frozen C5A LARE equations, phase decomposition, timestep/state/closure effect-size calculations
pre_execution_implementation_binding.prohibited_new_code: new fitted closure, partition optimization, acceptance threshold changes, production implementation
